variables.name: NATS_URL
variables.help:
The NATS server to connect to.

Required: no address is right on every host (#617). Compose's services set theirs; `make dev` takes its role's.

variables.name: RUST_LOG
variables.help:
`tracing` filter directives, e.g. `info,async_nats=warn`.

A filter that does not parse stops the binary at start.
